# VegetationLibrary

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/logic/vegetation/vegetation.h`](../../../src/logic/vegetation/vegetation.h) · Described in `data/world.json`

Host context variable: the index of resources/vegetation (SpeedTree species imported by tools/speedtree_import.py).

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `directory` | `std::filesystem::path` | the library folder (./resources/vegetation, else the source tree's) |
| `species` | `std::vector<VegetationLibrary::Species>` | id, name, category (ground, shrub, tree), height, radius, triangles of the most detailed level, number of levels |

## Notes

Created on first use by vegetationLibrary(reg) (Forest, VegetationScatter, VegetationLineup, VegetationPass, HerdSys, CameraWalk...), empty when the folder has no library.json. loadSpecies / loadGeometry read species/<id>.json and .bin on demand.

## Side effects of those systems

- **[CameraWalk](../systems/CameraWalk.md)**
  - Log lines "CameraWalk : from x z heading ..." (plan), soil / herds scores, and each herd it turns to.
  - profile::message("CameraWalk : started") when the route is made and ("CameraWalk : finished") at the end: tools/profile_run.py --between cuts on them; DY_FRAME_NAMED("Walk") marks every frame of the walk; CPU zone "Route the walk".
  - Reads species geometry files through VegetationLibrary::loadSpecies / loadGeometry (once per species, main thread).
  - With "exit", ends the process at the end of the walk (Input::EXIT).
- **[Forest](../systems/Forest.md)**
  - Connects to on_destroy<ChunkForest> in preinit (onChunkForestDestroyed), disconnects in finish.
  - Reads ./resources/forest/tautavel.forest.json (or `definition`) in init, and resources/vegetation/library.json through vegetationLibrary when no system loaded it yet.
  - Creates the plant entities, destroys them with their chunk.
  - Logs info (stands, layers, species, patch size), a warning per species the library lacks, an error without a terrain generator or with a bad definition (the system then does nothing).
- **[HerdWatch](../systems/HerdWatch.md)**
  - Moves the desktop camera every tick once it has a herd.
  - Logs the herd it chose.
  - Queries the ground field up to ten times a tick.
- **[Herds](../systems/Herds.md)**
  - Reads the herd definition JSON under ./resources/ in init.
  - Creates and destroys member entities as the viewer moves (destroying every component on them).
  - Logs warnings for missing members, an error for a bad definition, an info line at init, a debug line per herd spawned.
  - Queries the ground field per member per tick and the generator's heightfield for slopes.
- **[PlantVolumes](../systems/service-PlantVolumes.md)**
  - Allocates three 3D images per baked species; records bake dispatches and mip blits into the frame's compute command buffer.
  - Writes Context::plant_volumes (view set bindings 10 to 12).
  - Logs an info line per volume baked.
- **[ProbeVolume](../systems/service-ProbeVolume.md)**
  - Allocates pages of 3D probe textures (61 MB each, logged), uploads the brick table and the probe classes.
  - Records the probe dispatches into the frame's compute command buffer.
  - Writes the Context probe pointers read by every view set; waits for the device when its buffer grows.
- **[TreeShade](../systems/service-TreeShade.md)**
  - Signals: connects on_construct<Plant> and on_destroy<Plant> (disconnected in the destructor).
  - GPU: uploads a new 2048x2048 R8 image through Transfer whenever a plant came or went or the light moved (1 degree, 10 with ray tracing); old ones kept for the frames in flight; sets Context::tree_shade_view and tree_shade_sampler.
- **[VegetationLineup](../systems/VegetationLineup.md)**
  - Creates the lineup's entities once in init (never destroyed by the system).
  - Logs one info line per plant (species, level, position, height).
- **[VegetationScatter](../systems/VegetationScatter.md)**
  - Connects to on_destroy<ChunkPlants> in preinit, disconnects in finish.
  - Reads resources/vegetation/library.json through vegetationLibrary when no system loaded it yet.
  - Creates plant entities, destroys them with their chunk.
  - Logs the selected species (info) and a warning per unknown id.
- **[vegetation](../systems/pass-vegetation.md)**
  - Loads species geometry and textures on taskflow workers (silent_async, 6 at a time); uploads buffers and textures, allocates descriptor sets.
  - Logs each species loaded, errors for species and textures that fail.
  - With ray tracing gives meshes and textures to the rays (RayMeshes).
  - Records the plant draws and the far volume boxes of both targets; the destructor waits for running jobs.
